data.action: 对着随身镜调整假发与饰品，回眸比出角色招牌姿势，元气满满
data.camera: medium shot, adjusting her wig and accessories before a dressing-room mirror
data.description: 【喜多川海梦 · 漫展后台】开幕前十分钟的后台更衣区，化妆镜的环形灯亮得晃眼。穿着泛用 cosplay 服的海梦对着随身镜最后调整假发角度，忽然回眸冲你比出角色的招牌姿势——「怎么样怎么样！这个还原度！等会儿走场的时候，眼睛只准看我一个人哦！」
data.lighting: 后台化妆镜环形灯与帘缝漏进的日光交错，碎金般落在肩头
data.promptProse: Marin checks her wig and character accessories in the backstage mirror, then turns to make the cosplay's signature pose with lively anticipation. The playful character costume remains distinct from her daily clothes. The medium view includes the portable mirror near the dressing surface and curtains behind her. Warm ring lighting illuminates the wig strands and makeup, while daylight through a curtain gap catches the accessory edges and casts a narrow stripe across the table.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 漫展后台·开幕前的最后调整
